Berry Edwards should link here
Berry H. Edwards was a register of deeds and state legislator in North Carolina for Alleghany County.
He was register of deeds in Alleghany County in 1868.
His son Berry Edwards Jr. served in the Civil War.
He left land to heir in his will.
